name: Endou Daisuke
source:
[url=/c73540]Achi[/url] and [url=/c87869]Suzune[/url]'s father. Owner of Endo Electronics.

Daisuke is an alum from Tokyo Denko University, attending on a full scholarship. His knowledge in electronics and worry about delinquent activity led him to develop the local surveillance system used throughout Shibuya's shopping districts.

[spoiler]Daisuke is the culprit of the kidnapping case, having mistakenly kidnapped Maria while attempting to capture and kill [url=/c73545]Hitomi[/url] for a heart transplant for his daughter, Suzune. He was coerced into the crime as part of [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url]'s master plot to steal the Ua antiviral.[/spoiler]
